scores.evidence: Nothing overflows or is clipped at 390 px or 1440 px. The s2-flow diagram has readable Japanese labels at both widths (mobile-jp-07/08, desktop-jp-05), and the definition tables and todo.html code read well (mobile-jp-19/20). Every steps block shows its number twice, though: the reader's green circle plus a ① in the title (mobile-jp-10, desktop-jp-07, desktop-jp-14, desktop-jp-17).

There are no text-only screens. Each segment gets a table, figure, prompt or check within one mobile screen. The longest dense run is s4-interview: about 13 lines of prompt text on mobile-jp-16. Desktop chars per line: median 39, max 46, against a 30–40 target.

All Japanese, with the English term given in brackets on first use. Contrast is good on the callouts and the code. Keyboard hints show on the checks (desktop-jp-02). Nothing is hidden under the mobile top or bottom bars. No personal data appears on any screen.

mustFix.issue: Each step is numbered twice. The reader draws a numbered circle, and each title starts again with ①–⑥ ('1  ① プランモードに入り、探索させる'). This adds noise and makes the narrow mobile title wrap ('⑤ 差分を説明させ、/予想してから確かめる').
mustFix.fix: Remove the leading circled numbers from the step titles of ex-explore through ex-commit (for example 'プランモードに入り、探索させる').

mustFix.issue: The same double numbering appears in practice 1: the circles 1–7 plus ①–⑦ at the start of each title (pr-setup through pr-commit).
mustFix.fix: Remove the leading ①–⑦ from the titles of pr-setup, pr-rewrite, pr-explore, pr-plan, pr-implement, pr-explain and pr-commit.

mustFix.issue: The same double numbering appears in practice 2: the circles 1–3 plus ①–③ in the titles of ps-feature, ps-ask and ps-spec.
mustFix.fix: Remove the leading ①–③ from the three step titles.

niceToHave: On mobile the reflection line for objective o1 leaves a single 'る' on its own line ('…具体的に書き直せ / る', mobile-jp-34, and the same on desktop-jp-23). A slightly shorter objective text, such as dropping '具体的に', would avoid this.
s4-interview is one dense block of about 13 lines on mobile (mobile-jp-16). Splitting its second paragraph so each topic sits on its own line would make it easier to scan.

reader: the model-answer prompt blocks (practice-model, practice-spec-model) are fully visible even though their titles say '書いてから見比べましょう' (write first, then compare) (desktop-jp-16, desktop-jp-18). A collapsed or reveal state would support the write-first instruction.
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson. That is expected for a draft that is not in course.json.
reader: the full-length mobile PNG is truncated at 16000px. All 35 per-screen PNGs were reviewed.
summary: The lesson renders cleanly at 390 px and 1440 px. There are no overflows, errors or privacy findings, the plan-mode flowchart is legible in Japanese, and the code, tables, keycaps and checks all read well. The only must-fix is cosmetic and quick: drop the ①② numbers from the step titles in s3-steps, practice-steps and practice-spec-steps, because the reader already numbers each step.
